music.respect: Music is off today out of respect.

defaults.slogan: Welcome to the city. Your story starts in a few seconds.

rules.title: No meta-gaming
rules.body: Don't use info your character doesn't know.

rules.title: No power-gaming
rules.body: Give others a chance to respond.

rules.title: Respect green zones
rules.body: No fights near hospitals or police stations.

tips.title: Open your phone
tips.body: Press F1 to open your phone and sign up.

tips.title: First stop: City Hall
tips.body: Visit City Hall to get your ID.

new-year.name: New Year
new-year.message: Happy New Year! Let's welcome {nextYear} together in the city.
new-year.label: EVENT

valentines.name: Valentine's Day
valentines.message: Happy Valentine's Day! A romantic night in the city is waiting for you.
valentines.label: VALENTINE'S

womens-day.name: International Women's Day
womens-day.message: Happy International Women's Day to every woman who makes this city better.
womens-day.label: HOLIDAY

april-fools.name: April Fools' Day
april-fools.message: Don't believe everything you hear in the city today. Especially this.
april-fools.label: APRIL FOOLS'

mothers-day.name: Mother's Day
mothers-day.message: Happy Mother's Day! Call your mom first, the city can wait.
mothers-day.label: HOLIDAY

fathers-day.name: Father's Day
fathers-day.message: Happy Father's Day to every dad in the city.
fathers-day.label: HOLIDAY

community-day.name: Community Day
community-day.message: GTA V turns {years} today! Thanks for keeping this city alive.
community-day.label: COMMUNITY

halloween.name: Halloween
halloween.message: Strange things are happening in the city tonight. Stay safe.
halloween.label: HALLOWEEN

black-friday.name: Black Friday
black-friday.message: The sales are on. Expect long lines at every store in town.
black-friday.label: DEALS

st-patricks.name: St. Patrick's Day
st-patricks.message: Happy St. Patrick's Day! Wear something green tonight.
st-patricks.label: HOLIDAY

easter.name: Easter
easter.message: Happy Easter! Keep an eye out for hidden eggs around the city.
easter.label: HOLIDAY

memorial-day.name: Memorial Day
memorial-day.message: Today we honor those who gave their lives in service.
memorial-day.label: REMEMBRANCE

independence-day.name: Independence Day
independence-day.message: Happy Fourth of July! Fireworks over the pier tonight.
independence-day.label: HOLIDAY

labor-day.name: Labor Day
labor-day.message: Happy Labor Day! Thanks to everyone who keeps this city running.
labor-day.label: HOLIDAY

veterans-day.name: Veterans Day
veterans-day.message: Today we honor everyone who served.
veterans-day.label: REMEMBRANCE

thanksgiving.name: Thanksgiving
thanksgiving.message: Happy Thanksgiving! Grateful for every story in this city.
thanksgiving.label: HOLIDAY

christmas.name: Christmas

christmas.label: HOLIDAY

eta.label: Estimated time
eta.hint: Based on the player's last load time

content.glassLimit: Glass shows the first 4 items of each tab. Minimal rotates through all of them.

media.bgHint: Local files must live in web/media/ (e.g. media/background.webp). Use WebM for video. Don't use Discord CDN links, they expire.
media.logoHint: Leave empty to show the initials of your full name.
media.corsError: Couldn't read colors from this image (the host doesn't allow CORS). Put the logo in web/media/logo/ and use a local path.
media.loadError: Couldn't load the logo. Check the path.
media.noColors: No distinct color found in the logo.
media.playlistEmpty: The playlist is empty. The music card is hidden on the loading screen.

calendar.title: SCHEDULED THEMES
calendar.hint: A scheduled theme is layered on top of yours: only color, tint, effect, badge and message change. Layout, logo and server name stay the same.
calendar.inactive: No special day on this date.
calendar.disabledGlobal: Scheduled themes are disabled in config.lua (Config.ScheduledThemesEnabled).
calendar.defaultPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default text
calendar.vars: Variables: {years} anniversary · {days} days until New Year · {year} · {nextYear}

share.codeHint: Media files are not included in the code, only https:// links.
share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and press Ctrl+C.
share.imported: Theme imported. Press Save to apply it.

history.title: RECENT SAVES
history.hint: The last 5 saves are kept. Restoring creates a new save too.
history.confirm: Restore this save? Unsaved changes will be lost.

stats.title: STATISTICS
stats.empty: No data yet. It fills up as players connect.

toast.warnings: Some fields were invalid and kept their previous value: {fields}

errors.no_permission: You don't have permission to do this.

errors.write_failed: Couldn't write the file (check write access to data/).
